== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Soulsmiths are specialized craftsmen who manipulate spiritual essence to create various objects. Their work includes forging weapons, developing [[constructs]], and crafting prosthetics or sacred instruments. They are also capable of transplanting binding{{!}}bindings from [[Remnants]] into [[sacred artists]] or creating specialized items like memory [[constructs]]. This profession is highly respected and can serve as a significant source of wealth for clans or families, though the training required is extensive and does not necessarily provide combat advantages. A fundamental skill for a [[Soulsmith]] is the ability to reshape [[madra]], which involves filling gaps in [[dead matter]] to create functional shells around binding{{!}}bindings. Success in this craft requires a precise understanding of [[Remnant]] structures, as even similar spirits can have different internal configurations. To assist in this analytical process, Soulsmiths often create drudges—specialized [[constructs]] that serve as assistants, encyclopedias, and scanning tools to identify valuable binding{{!}}bindings. The craft involves significant risk; incompatibility between a [[Soulsmith]]'s power and the materials used can result in useless or dangerous products. Mastery of the art often requires specialized tools, such as hammers used to inject a smith's will into an object, and dedicated workspaces like foundries. At the highest levels of the craft, Soulsmiths may utilize advanced locations or tools like a [[Soulforge]] to imbue items with the Authority{{!}}authority and [[willpower]] of powerful beings.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Soulsmiths are individuals specialized in the crafting of armor. Within the local economy, these artisans engage in the purchase of [[Remnants]] to facilitate their work. However, some renegade members of the profession were apprehended after attempting to sell defective healing [[constructs]]. In the region of [[Ghostwater]], Soulsmiths have also been known to leave behind various information [[constructs]]. Following a command from [[King Dakata]], the smiths were ordered to complete the production of new armor.}}
